Under controlled experiments, LARC performs remarkabletest-time scaling behavior, outperforming the best-of-N sampling on image generation[1], image editing[27], and visual reasoning[75]tasks.

Figure 2:Overview of LARC.Our framework, LARC, consists of two stages. (1)Stage 1adapts supervised fine-tuning (SFT) while gradually introducing latent thought on continuous space where the last hidden state of UMM becomes the next input embedding of the model. (2)Stage 2adapts self-evolving reinforcement learning (RL) with information-gain reward derived from the internal knowledge.πref\pi_{\text{ref}}denotes SFT model trained in Stage 1. Dotted line is task-specific option.
